title: Eleven Bars Nobody Could Play
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：note　|　正文 371 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 note 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My great-aunt played the violin badly for sixty-one years and never once played it in public, which I used to think was a waste and now think was the point. She had one ① note in her that was true, a top A, and she built a whole private life around it. The rest of her ② notes were, by any honest account, approximations.

She taught me at the kitchen table. 'Listen to the ③ note,' she would say, 'not the tune,' and then she would play the same four bars for eleven minutes until I heard what she meant. I was nine and impatient, and ④ noted nothing down, which she said was correct: a child who writes music before hearing it will always play what is written and never what is there.

There was a ten-shilling ⑤ note in the case, folded in half, beside a note from a teacher in 1946, which said she had 'a good ear and no future' and which she kept for the rest of her life. I found it after her death and I have never decided whether she kept it as evidence or as a joke. What I ⑥ note now, reading it again, is the note of kindness in it, which is thinner than I remembered.

In 1998 she gave me the violin and, on a separate ⑦ note, a list of eleven things not to do with it: no radiators, no boots, no attics, no aunts. Everything on that list was something she had done. What she cared about most, however, was a note she had never been able to play, and she asked me, at ninety, to ⑧ take note of whether such a note existed.

Every note, she had told me once, is a decision somebody else already made. I looked it up. It does, it is a B flat above the stave, and it is not difficult. I told her, and she laughed for four minutes, and then she ⑨ noted that she had been ninety for eleven months and had not thought to ask until then. She died the following spring. I still have the violin, the ⑩ note of 1946 and the list, and I have never once taken the instrument out of its case.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 便条；短笺；纸条
D. n. 口气；调子；意味（a note of）
E. v. 注意到；察觉（note that）
F. v. 记录；记下（note sth down）
G. 固定搭配：take note of 留意；注意
H. n. 注释；按语；说明

items.q: She had one note in her that was true
The rest of her notes were
There was a ten-shilling note in the case
What I note now, reading it again, is the note of kindness
on a separate note, a list of eleven things
to take note of whether such a note existed
she noted that she had been ninety for eleven months
the note of 1946 and the list

answers.why: 指“音、音符”，说她身上只有一个音是准的：高音 A。
同样指“音符”，说她其余的音老实说都只是近似。
指那个“音”，她让我听音而不是听曲子。
note down 作动词，意为“记下、写下”，说我什么也没记，她认为这反而对。
note 指“纸币、钞票”，说琴盒里还有一张对折的十先令钞票。
the note of kindness 意为“善意的口气、意味”，而 note 作动词意为“注意到”。
on a separate note 意为“另外附上一张说明／按语”，此处指另给的一张清单。
take note of 意为“留意、查明”，说她九十岁时让我去查一查是否真有这个音。
动词，意为“（她）指出、说到”，说她提到自己九十岁已十一个月。
指1946年那张“便条”，与清单一起被我留着。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 她身上只有一个音是准的：高音A。（note）
听那个音，不要听那支曲子。（note）
我什么也没记下来，她反而说这是对的做法。（note down）
琴盒里有一张对折的便条，是1946年一位老师写的。（note）
如今重读，我注意到的是其中那点善意的口气。（note / a note of）
另外她还给了我一张清单，上面写着十一件不该做的事。（on a separate note）
answers: She had one note in her that was true: a top A.
Listen to the note, not the tune.
I noted nothing down, and she said that was correct.
There was a note in the case, folded in half, from a teacher in 1946.
What I note now is the note of kindness in it.
On a separate note she gave me a list of eleven things not to do with it.
